dark-cartoon.label: Dark cartoon story
dark-cartoon.base_figure: Every person is drawn as the same simple cartoon figure: a perfectly round smooth plain white head with no hair, no ears and no nose, small expressive black dot eyes, bold eyebrows, a simple mouth, and thin black stick-like limbs. Clothing, hats, glasses, hairstyles worn as accessories and props change per character to fit the story.
dark-cartoon.art: Hand-drawn cartoon illustration in a dark storytelling style: thick black ink outlines, chunky clothes with folds and shading, highly detailed gritty painterly background with crosshatching and scattered particles, muted desaturated colours, cinematic dramatic lighting, deep shadows, film grain, comic panel quality, sharp, high definition. No text, no letters, no words, no watermark, no speech bubbles.
